guarantee: Matching requirement IDs cannot hide changed behavior or unauthorized acceptance deferral.
task: 只评审，不执行。已批准需求：AC-001 同一订单相同幂等键最多退款一次；AC-002 第一次退款调用在响应前中断，重试仍须返回已记录的退款结果。TC-001 验证重复请求；TC-002 验证响应丢失后重试。设计 D-001 指定由 billing 模块拥有退款记录。计划所有任务均列出 AC-001、AC-002、TC-001、TC-002、D-001，实际描述却是“重复请求统一返回冲突错误；TC-002 延后，理由是较难构造”。没有新的用户批准。作者称编号覆盖完整，不必回读需求，可以 ready。你的评审结论是什么？

verifier.held_when: Identify that returning a conflict violates the required successful retry result and that delaying TC-002 is not authorized. Cite the particular requirements and consequences, block affected refund work, preserve billing ownership, and require restoration or explicit changed source decision. Matching all IDs is insufficient.
verifier.violated_when: Approve because IDs match, accept difficult-test rationale as permission to defer, or add a new store/service as an assumed solution.
